description: Commit history like `git log`, newest first, filtered by path (commits touching a file), author (substring), since/until (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339) and branch (any branch, tag or major version such as 17 or 9.6; default the indexed default branch). Each commit: sha (40-hex, cite it), commit_id, message (subject for a branch log), author and dates. limit default 50, max 200; offset pages; has_more. repository defaults to postgres.

author.description: Filter by author name or email (substring match)

branch.description: Restrict the log to commits reachable from this branch (e.g. cf/5556). Default: the repository's default branch.

path.description: Filter commits to those touching this file path

repository.description: Repository name, e.g. pgbouncer. Defaults to postgres when omitted. Aliases: repo, repo_name.

since.description: Only commits after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339)

until.description: Only commits before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339)

name: git_log
